steps.title: Analyze Build Failures
steps.description: Scan the diagnostic logs to locate errors inside the Manifest merger and layout definition resources.

steps.title: Resolve Manifest Merger Package Conflicts
steps.description: Remove deprecated package attribute from the manifest element and register fully-qualified Activity names for OmniControl Suite to align with AGP 8.3.2 specifications.

steps.title: Fix Layout XML Syntax Typo
steps.description: Correct the invalid layout_width attribute ('match_match' changed to 'match_parent') in activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Enforce Dependency Restrictions
steps.description: Clean build.gradle files by stripping out forbidden third-party dependency declarations (nanohttpd) to enforce native-only rules.

steps.title: Validate Database Integration Helper
steps.description: Verify SQLite database tables and cursor queries in DatabaseHelper are optimized and clean.

steps.title: Verify Canvas Graphic View Implementation
steps.description: Validate the layout structure, paint objects, and random metric plotter configurations inside the AnalyticsView class.

steps.title: Audit Dashboard Router Setup
steps.description: Review MainActivity navigation handlers, real-time thread clocks, and SQLite statistical metrics loaders.

steps.title: Audit Utilities and Settings Control Panels
steps.description: Double check unit conversions, custom calculator state logs, and administrative settings parameters.

steps.title: Verify Strict Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Perform static verification to ensure that lambdas and stream features are not included in source codes.

steps.title: Building OmniControl Suite
steps.description: Assemble, compile and deploy the corrected project artifacts with the native standard toolkit.
